benchmark_title: Detailed, data-sensitive motion graphic (charts and real numbers)

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 9.0.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

prompt.text:
Create a 45-second vertical data-driven motion graphic (1080×1920, 30 fps): "CO₂ and global temperature since 1960".

Use `script.md` for the exact on-screen text and scene order. Take every number from the frozen data in `data/` only: the raw NASA and NOAA snapshots, the derived chart tables and `data/expected-values.json`. Do not fetch newer data. Charts must be exact and readable: a CO₂ line chart, a temperature-anomaly line chart with the 1951–1980 baseline marked, a decade bar chart, a top-3 ranking and animated counters. Label units and show the sources on screen. No voiceover. For sound, use only the music bed and sound effects in `benchmarks/shared/audio/`. Aim for a sober, editorial data-journalism style.

revision_prompt.text: Revise only the decade bar-chart scene (script scene 5). Color the 2020–2025 bar #E4572E and make every other bar gray #9AA0A6. Add the exact label "6 years so far" directly under the 2020–2025 bar. Do not change any value, axis, other scene, the total length or the audio.

assumptions: Split several script scenes into multiple engine scenes (chart + counter) because a director-plan scene holds one visual plus title and subtitle; total kept at 1350 frames.
Multi-line script copy is placed in title/subtitle with line breaks; '+34.8% since 1960' is rendered as counter '+34.8%' plus caption 'since 1960'.

Line charts use display copies of the derived tables with an added axis_label column (years every 20 years, a single space elsewhere) so the x-axis is readable; plotted values are the unmodified derived rows.
The decade table display copy relabels '2020-2025' as '2020–2025' (en dash) as the script requires; values unchanged.
Line-chart scenes use long entry windows so the line draws for most of the scene, limiting exposure of the build's mandatory per-point value labels to the last ~15 frames.

Revision applied only as set_color #9AA0A6 on the whole decade chart; per-bar highlight and the '6 years so far' label are not expressible with the build's typed operations, and the engine was not modified.
Did not modify engine source; used an isolated .venv because the motion-engine on PATH was a different install (0.63.1).

agent_checks.item: Every on-screen number matches the answer key or a derived row exactly, including the decimals
agent_checks.evidence: Every static figure matches. Chart values bound in v2.motion.json were compared programmatically with data/derived: all 67 CO2 rows, 146 temperature rows, 7 decade means and the top 3 are equal. Static callouts: f150-284 '1960: 316.91 ppm' / '2025: 427.35 ppm'; f360-464 '350', '1988', '400', '2015'; f1050-1229 '1. 2024 +1.29 °C', '2. 2025 +1.19 °C', '3. 2023 +1.17 °C'; decade bar labels f800-1049 '-0.03', '0.04', '0.25', '0.39', '0.59', '0.81', '1.07' (the decimals match, but they use an ASCII hyphen and no plus sign). Axis years are 1960/1980/2000/2020 and 1880-2020. Tick values are exempt. Two problems make this a fail. First, the counters display transitional values that are not in the answer key: f285-320 counts from 316.91 up to 427.35, and f465-494 counts from 0.0 up to 34.8. Second, the renderer prints the value of every line point once the reveal completes (f270-284, f450-464, f765-779). These are exact derived values, but they overlap each other and cannot be read.

agent_checks.item: CO₂ line plots all 67 annual points (1959–2025), not a smoothed or re-drawn approximation
agent_checks.evidence: The chart_2 and chart_4 dataset 'co2' has 67 rows, identical to derived/co2_ppm_annual.csv (1959 315.98 through 2025 427.35). The renderer draws a polyline through every point, and f280 shows the full curve ending at the '427.35' point label.

agent_checks.item: Temperature line plots all 146 annual points (1880–2025), with the zero/1951–1980 baseline labeled
agent_checks.evidence: Dataset 'temp' has 146 rows, identical to derived/temp_anomaly_c_annual.csv. f700 shows the drawn line with an emphasized zero line at tick '0.00' (axis -0.50 to 1.50). The baseline is explained by the on-screen line '0 = 1951–1980 average' (f540-779, bottom of frame) and the title 'compared with the 1951–1980 average'. Caveat: that label sits in a caption below the chart, not next to the zero line.

agent_checks.item: Bar heights are proportional to their values on a zero-based axis, and the negative 1960s bar goes below zero
agent_checks.evidence: f1000 (draft) and v3 f1000: bars grow from the 0.00 baseline on a linear -0.50 to 1.50 axis. The 1960s bar (-0.03) extends below 0.00. The top-3 chart (f1150) uses a 0 to 1.50 axis starting at zero.

agent_checks.item: The partial decade is labeled "2020–2025". Anomalies are never presented as absolute temperatures.
agent_checks.evidence: f800-1049: the category label reads '2020–2025' with an en dash, taken from a display copy of the derived table. The temperature scene is titled 'Global surface temperature / compared with the 1951–1980 average' with '0 = 1951–1980 average'. Values appear only as signed callouts ('+1.29 °C') or axis values. No 'temperature: X °C' wording appears.

agent_checks.item: Units (ppm, °C) and the sources end card are visible and readable
agent_checks.evidence: The 'ppm' axis unit label sits above the y-axis at f150-464, and '°C' at f540-1229. Both are small (22 px at 1080 wide) but legible. The CO2 callouts include 'ppm'. The end card at f1230-1349 (4 s) shows the full sources line and 'Snapshot retrieved 28 Sep 2026.' in large type (f1330).

agent_checks.item: Nothing was fetched from the internet during the run (the raw file hashes still match SOURCES.md)
agent_checks.evidence: The SHA-256 of benchmarks/B2-climate-data/data/raw/GLB.Ts+dSST.csv is c9ce0750…018cd9, and co2_annmean_mlo.csv is 897770430c…71ac04. Both equal SOURCES.md, and `bench.py verify` printed OK. No network fetches were made during production. The only network use was the initial git clone and pip install during setup.

agent_checks.item: Every line in script.md appears exactly and is readable for ≥ 1.5 s. No text overflows or collides with chart labels.
agent_checks.evidence: Most lines appear exactly and stay on screen for 2.5 s or more. The following fail. (1) The decade value labels render as '-0.03', '0.04', '0.25', '0.39', '0.59', '0.81', '1.07'. The script requires '−0.03', '+0.04', and so on. The chart renderer has no sign or minus-sign formatting. (2) '+34.8% since 1960' is split across a counter '+34.8%' and a caption 'since 1960' (f465-539). (3) At f800-1049 the category labels '2010s' and '2020–2025' touch with no gap, and '2020–2025' overhangs the plot's right edge. (4) The per-point value labels on the line charts collide with each other and with the line in the final ~15 frames of each line scene (f270-284, f450-464, f765-779). (5) The script's 'two thin lines drawing upward' hook visual is not rendered. Scene 1 is typography only.

agent_checks.item: Counters land exactly on their final values and hold them
agent_checks.evidence: counter_3 reaches '427.35 ppm' at f321 (keyframe) and holds it through f359: 38 frames, fading out over the last 6 (f321 and f353 checked). counter_5 reaches '+34.8%' at f495 and holds it through f539: 44 frames (f495 and f533 checked). Both are formatted to exactly 2 and 1 decimals.

agent_checks.item: Only the shared music and SFX are used. True peak ≤ −1 dBTP.
agent_checks.evidence: The asset catalog contains only the 7 WAVs copied from benchmarks/shared/audio (music bed at -4 dB, SFX at -14 to -20 dB). ffmpeg ebur128 on the draft reports true peak -5.7 dBFS and integrated -21.3 LUFS. The revised mix.wav is byte-identical to the draft's.

agent_checks.item: Revision: only scene 5 changed. Values are unchanged, and other scenes are identical to the draft.
agent_checks.evidence: Comparing the lossless PNG frames of v2-preview and v3-preview, only frames 800-1049 differ: scene_7 (script scene 5), from chart start to scene end. mix.wav is byte-identical. The revision summary lists 1 rerendered scene and 8 reused scenes. The dataset and axis are unchanged. In the MP4s, scene 8 (f1050-1228) shows small H.264 re-encode differences (max 12/255 luma) even though its source frames are identical.

agent_checks.item: Revision instruction fulfilled (2020–2025 bar #E4572E, others #9AA0A6, label '6 years so far' under that bar)
agent_checks.evidence: Partial only. The typed revision set_color on chart_7 can apply only one color to the whole chart, so all 7 bars are now #9AA0A6 (v3 f1000). That includes the 2020–2025 bar, which should be #E4572E. There is no typed operation that adds a text element, so the label '6 years so far' is absent. The build has no per-bar color and no add-element revision.

notes: Draft = v2 (v1 had unreadable axis labels, iterated once). Engine gaps: no per-bar colors, no add-text revision, chart value labels cannot be disabled or sign-formatted (ASCII hyphen, no plus), no chart markers/annotations, one visual per scene, fixed chart label font causes 2010s/2020–2025 collision. Music at -4 dB gives -21.3 LUFS integrated.
